name: Nacionalidad Colombiana por Nacimiento (Hijo de Padre o Madre Colombiana en el Exterior)

qualifying_event.description: A child born abroad to a Colombian father or mother is entitled to Colombian nationality by birth, formalised via civil registration ('registro civil de nacimiento') at a Colombian consulate.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Legalized/apostilled foreign birth certificate; Colombian parent's cédula; blood type/RH certificate.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least one parent to be a Colombian citizen at the time of the child's birth. Registration is NOT automatic -- the parent(s) must initiate civil registration at the Colombian consulate in the country of birth. No cost and no residence requirement for this consular process, though Article 1 of Ley 43 de 1993 separately contemplates children of Colombian parents who later establish domicile in Colombia -- this dataset follows the tier-1-confirmed consular-registration mechanism actually used in practice.
requirements.fix_path: Register the birth at a Colombian consulate.

evidence_required.document: Legalized/apostilled foreign birth certificate (original, not a copy)
Colombian parent's current cédula (with holograms), or authenticated death certificate if deceased

sources.title: Consulado de Colombia en Quito -- Pasos para el registro civil de nacimiento o nacionalidad por nacimiento: documents, process, no cost, no residence requirement stated
Ley 43 de 1993 -- Article 1 (nationality by birth for children of Colombian parents born abroad) and Article 2 (retention of Colombian nationality alongside another)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Colombia's initial build. Confirmed at both tier-1 (consular process page) and tier-2 (the underlying 1993 law). Dual nationality explicitly preserved per Ley 43 Article 2. Kept SEPARATE from co_naturalisation's naturalization-based routes -- this is a jus sanguinis registration, not an application-and-assessment process.
